 Breece Hall is not expected to play against Raiders
 By
 Josh Alper , 
 By
 Josh Alper 
     Published November 1, 2026 09:21 AM 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Email
 The Jets are set to play without running back Breece Hall again this Sunday. 
 Hall has missed the last four games with a quad injury and Ian Rapoport of NFL Media reports that he is expected to be inactive against the Raiders. Hall has been practicing on a limited basis for the last two weeks and he’s been listed as questionable, but it appears the wait for his return will continue. 
 Braelon Allen has been the Jets’ lead back in Hall’s absence. He has 72 carries for 357 yards and a touchdown during his time in the starting lineup.
 The Jets are also likely to be without linebacker David Bailey. The first-round pick is listed as doubtful due to a groin injury.
